title: Chimney Rock marks the moon's 18.6-year standstill

tellings.quote: you peer through those through those two pinnacle rocks and it marks that position where you will see every 18.6 years you will see the moon rising in between those two rocks.

plain: At Chimney Rock in Colorado, two tall pinnacles of rock are said to frame the exact spot where, once every 18.6 years, the moon can be seen rising between them. A researcher named Randall Carlson describes this to Michels, without naming a source, as evidence that the people who used the site were tracking the moon's long cycle with care.
